headline: US military disables bulk carrier in the Gulf of Oman according to Central Command
label: BREAKING
caption:
US forces have taken action against a bulk carrier in the Gulf of Oman. 🚢

According to US Central Command, military forces disabled the bulk carrier during operations in the area.

Further details regarding the incident and the status of the crew have not been immediately detailed by authorities.
